points.name: shoulder_left
points.instruction: Left outer shoulder seam end, where the sleeve joins the shoulder

points.name: shoulder_right
points.instruction: Right outer shoulder seam end, where the sleeve joins the shoulder

points.name: neck_shoulder
points.instruction: Highest point of the shoulder seam next to the neck

points.name: bust_left
points.instruction: Left armpit seam, where the sleeve meets the body

points.name: bust_right
points.instruction: Right armpit seam, where the sleeve meets the body

points.name: waist_left
points.instruction: Left side seam at the narrowest point of the body (skip if the kurti is straight cut)

points.name: waist_right
points.instruction: Right side seam at the same height as waist_left

points.name: hip_left
points.instruction: Left side seam at the widest point below the waist (skip if the kurti is straight cut)

points.name: hip_right
points.instruction: Right side seam at the same height as hip_left

points.name: hem_left
points.instruction: Left bottom corner of the hem

points.name: hem_right
points.instruction: Right bottom corner of the hem

points.name: hem_center
points.instruction: Bottom hem, straight below the neck_shoulder point

points.name: sleeve_end
points.instruction: End of the sleeve at the cuff edge, on the outer side (skip for sleeveless)
